title: Genomic characteristics of adipose-derived stromal cells induced into neurons based on single-cell RNA sequencing.
authors: Yuan, Xiaodong; Li, Wen; Liu, Qing; Long, Qingxi; Yan, Qi; Zhang, Pingshu
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于单细胞RNA测序分析脂肪间充质干细胞向神经元分化的基因组特征，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Adipose-derived stromal cells (ADSCs) can be induced to differentiate into neurons, representing the most promising avenue for cell therapy. However, the molecular mechanism and genomic characteristics of the differentiation of ADSCs into neurons remain poorly understood. In this study, cells from the adult ADSCs group, induction 1h, 3h, 5h, 6h, and 8h groups were selected for single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-Seq). Samples from these seven-time points were sequenced and analyzed. The expression of neuron marker genes, including NES, MAP2, TMEM59L, PTK2B, CHN1, DNM1, NRSN2, FBLN2, SCAMP1, SLC1A1, DLG4, CDK5, and ENO2, was found to be low in the ADSCs group, but highly expressed in differentiated cell clusters. The expression of stem cell marker genes, including CCND1, IL1B, MMP1, MMP3, MYO10, and BMP2, was the highest in the ADSCs cluster. This expression decreased significantly with the extension of induction time. Gene ontology (GO) enrichment analysis of upregulated genes in the induced samples showed that the biological processes related to neuronal differentiation and development, such as neuronal differentiation, projection, and apoptosis, were significantly upregulated with a longer induction time during cell cluster differentiation. The results of the cell communication analysis demonstrated the gradual formation of complex neural network connections between ADSC-derived neurons through receptor and ligand pairs at 5h after the induction of differentiation.
abstract_zh: 脂肪来源的基质细胞（ADSCs）可被诱导分化为神经元，代表了细胞治疗最有前景的途径。然而，ADSCs分化为神经元的分子机制和基因组特征仍知之甚少。本研究选取成年ADSCs组、诱导1小时、3小时、5小时、6小时和8小时组的细胞进行单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-Seq）。对这七个时间点的样本进行了测序和分析。研究发现，神经元标志基因（包括NES、MAP2、TMEM59L、PTK2B、CHN1、DNM1、NRSN2、FBLN2、SCAMP1、SLC1A1、DLG4、CDK5和ENO2）在ADSCs组中表达水平较低，但在分化细胞簇中高表达。干细胞标志基因（包括CCND1、IL1B、MMP1、MMP3、MYO10和BMP2）在ADSCs簇中表达最高，随着诱导时间的延长，该表达显著下降。对诱导样本中上调基因的基因本体论（GO）富集分析显示，与神经元分化和发育相关的生物学过程，如神经元分化、突起和凋亡，在细胞簇分化过程中随着诱导时间的延长而显著上调。细胞通讯分析结果表明，在诱导分化后5小时，ADSC来源的神经元之间通过受体和配体对逐渐形成复杂的神经网络连接。
